newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks slightly lower, selling slows.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks slightly lower, selling slows.

text.p: A lack of follow-through selling in Sri Lanka stocks on Wednesday has helped slow the recent decline in the market, brokers said.
The all share index was 1.87 points down at 737.93 at midday. Lanka Orix Leasing fell 15 rupees to 205, Lanka Lubricants 1.75 to 40.25.

"Sellers are moving out after taking profit in the last two to three days," said Ajit Dias Wanigasekera of Ceylinco Stock Brokers. Retail investors took profits earlier this week after the all share index gained over 25 points in the previous 10 days.
Final turnover is seen rising after 3.8 million Horana Plantation, 400,000 Ceylon Tea Services and 100,000 Kotagala Plantations, on bid at 32 rupees, 95 and 59 respectively, are concluded.
